import sys,json,unicodedata,warnings,io,contextlib
assert sys.version_info[:3]==(3,14,7) and unicodedata.unidata_version=='16.0.0'
source=json.load(sys.stdin)
output=io.StringIO()
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught,contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
 warnings.simplefilter('always')
 exec(compile(source,'codec-warning.py','exec'),{})
print(json.dumps({'reference':{'version':sys.version,'unicode':unicodedata.unidata_version,'platform':sys.platform,'byteorder':sys.byteorder},'stdout':output.getvalue(),'warnings':[{'category':w.category.__name__,'message':str(w.message),'filename':w.filename,'line':w.lineno} for w in caught]}))
adapters: Explicit warning and output adapters use partial fs.writeSync (at most three bytes); output flush uses fs.fsyncSync. Owned temporary files and descriptors cleaned up.
